thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING — p99 latency SLO breach detected for /v1/stream (redwood/quant-v2) across prod-west. p99 > 2s for last 6m, error budget triggered. Paging on-call now.

devon: oncall here. ACK. putting triage call on temporary channel #incident-2748004321-call.

sre-rotation: details? is this a spike or sustained? any obvious deploys?

incident-bot: recent config change detected 12m ago: precision_profile rollout -> "int8-aggressive-v2" applied to redwood/quant-v2 on prod-west (rollout fraction 100%).

nidhi: confirmed — I saw that rollout in the change log, was last-minute calibration tweak from perf experiments.

maria: observed symptom: streaming stalls at token boundaries after ~2k tokens, client sees stalled SSE chunks. p95 drifting from 220ms to 700ms, p99 2.4s -> 3.4s.

li: also seeing KV cache churn and coldstart spikes on the same nodes. heap and GPU memcpy stalls around the same timestamps.

aj: any customer impact flags?

customer-success: flagged two high-traffic customers on prod-west, no SLA hit notifications yet but they reported partial stream stalls. CS is reaching out.

devon: initial hypothesis: the int8-aggressive-v2 precision profile changes kernel selection and cache layout, causing KV-cache invalidation and dequant hot-path regressions for long-context streams. That would explain tail p99 and stream stalls.

eng-runtime-bot: correlated logs: model-serving node ids g-12,g-13,g-14 show repeated dequantize errors and memcopy backpressure. sample log snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T10:07:33Z] model=redwood/quant-v2 node=g-13 seq=2048 stall_ms=1450 kv_evictions=312 dequant_fail=0
[2026-03-15T10:08:05Z] model=redwood/quant-v2 node=g-12 seq=4096 stall_ms=2100 kv_evictions=512 dequant_fail=3
```

nidhi: dequant_fail > 0 is concerning — but dequant_fail counters are small. I think the bigger issue is eviction thrash plus kernel path falling back to a slower path for certain sequence lengths.

devon: mitigation plan proposal: 1) Rollback precision profile to previous stable (fp16-stable) for redwood/quant-v2 in prod-west, 2) Temporarily route streaming traffic to redwood/quant-fallback (fp16) variant for long-context routes, 3) Increase autoscale target for prod-west pools to absorb irregular throughput.

li: agree. rollback is fastest. can someone run the rollback API?

nidhi: on it. executing rollback now.

```
# rollback precision profile
redwoodctl rollout set-precision --model redwood/quant-v2 --profile fp16-stable --region prod-west --sync
```

eng-runtime-bot: acknowledged the rollout command. starting rollout cancel window and initiating profile switch. estimated propagation 30s-90s.

maria: watching metrics. p99 starting to move down in the first window. p95 back to ~260ms.

(30s later)

maria: p99 dropped from 3.4s -> 1.1s over last 3m. streaming stalls reduced, SSE chunk frequency normalizing.

customer-success: update — primary reporting customer says stream resumed, will keep monitoring.

aj: good. continue to keep traffic on fp16-stable while we root-cause. we should not re-enable int8-aggressive until we can repro in staging.

devon: agreed. marking precision profile rollout as reverted. creating follow-up tasks: 1) reproduce int8-aggressive-v2 in perf lab with long context (>2k tokens) and KV-cache instrumentation, 2) add guard to rollout process: require perf-runbook signoff for any precision profile that changes kernel selection, 3) add a runtime flag to limit int8 to short-sequence workloads.

nidhi: opening ticket INF-2748 with logs, heap/gpu traces, and step-by-step repro. attaching the calibration artifacts used in the rollout.

sre-rotation: any required customer communications?

customer-success: we'll send a brief note to impacted customers summarizing: root cause suspected as precision profile change -> cache eviction -> tail stalls. No data loss, change reverted, mitigation applied. Follow-up postmortem will be shared.

devon: action items assigned: nidhi (repro & logs), li (KV/cache metrics query + add alert for KV-eviction rate), aj (rollout policy guard), maria (postmortem draft), devon (followup with performance lab).

eng-runtime-bot: monitoring rule suggestion added: alert if p99 > 1.5s AND kv_evictions_rate > 100/min across >2 nodes.

maria: quick note — the rollout pipeline allowed a 100% ramp without perf gating. adding mandatory canary for precision-profile changes.

devon: closing the immediate paging loop — services stable, customers acknowledged. escalating to eng-runtime for root-cause deep dive.

incident-bot: incident status: RESOLVED (mitigated) — rollback applied, p99 back under SLO for last 10m. Postmortem required.

(threads continue in followup channel for postmortem and action tracking)
